en: A colorized vintage street scene showing a wide cobblestone road lined with low, colonial-style buildings with tiled roofs and balconies. People in early 20th‑century clothing, including several in white suits, walk and stand along the sidewalks; a horse‑drawn carriage is visible in the middle distance. The view looks straight down the street toward trees and more buildings. Printed caption text appears at the bottom.
